# Database

> For more information on the database, see the [Database doc](../database.md).

## Overview

An overview of the database can be found on the [ProfessorX page](https://professorx.githubapp.com/mysql/cluster/trust-metadata-api-production).

The Trust-Metadata-API database infrastructure is managed by the `#databases` team.

Details of the management provided by the databases team can be found in the [The Hub - GitHub Internal Platform MySQL](https://thehub.github.com/epd/engineering/github-internal-platform/data-storage/mysql).

## Incident Management

In the event of a database incident, check with the [`#databases-team`](https://github-grid.enterprise.slack.com/archives/C0FHZDN13).

Check the [`#incident-command`](https://github-grid.enterprise.slack.com/archives/C1AH2A4R2) channel to see if there is an incident in progress or to declare an incident.
